working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Germline' cluster(s) (Calderon et al. 2022), embryos 0-18 h.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Can be identified in the larva by expression of vasa (Slaidina et al., 2020). Only a small subset of pole cells can become germ cells and this fate might be specified by the time the posterior midgut primordium invaginates (Okada, 1998). Cell that begins as a pole cell, becomes incorporated into the gonad and can develop into a germline stem cell (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997; Dansereau and Lasko, 2008; Slaidina et al., 2020).

justification: The authors' annotation 'Germline'. Germline cells in the neuroectoderm re-clustering.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00000092 primordial germ cell (exact match).
